title: Bind toolkit self-host launcher to the current worktree
scope: Make toolkit-self-host launchers execute the current checkout's repository-local CLI by default and fail closed on an invalid local boundary.
Preserve version-pinned package recovery for ordinary installed projects and the explicit TEMPLE_CLI_PATH override.
No package publication, deployment, push, external write, model switch, or spend.
acceptance_criteria: A toolkit-self-host launcher invokes its own worktree-local bin/temple.mjs without TEMPLE_CLI_PATH even when another same-version Temple CLI is globally available.
Self-host bootstrap rejects a missing, escaping, or version-mismatched local CLI instead of falling back to npm or a global installation.
Ordinary-project bootstrap metadata and explicit compatible TEMPLE_CLI_PATH behavior remain covered.
Focused and full tests pass, then Independent QA reproduces default Doctor from a fresh detached exact-candidate worktree.
